name: Ampelognathus
sum: A small-bodied, possibly rhabdodontomorph ornithopod from the Cenomanian Lewisville Formation of Texas.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: DMNH 2021-05-02, from sediments of the Lewisville Formation, Texas.
biology: Probably more closely related to iguanodontians than to the older 'hypsilophodonts'; its habits are not described in the sources consulted.
author: Tykoski et al. 2023

images.artist: R. S. Tykoski, D. L. Contreras & C. Noto
images.caption: Holotype of Ampelognathus coheni
